_readme: OpenRouter pay-per-token rates, $/1M tokens, for the Cohort 1 open-weight frontier models.

Source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (the `pricing` block, per-token, multiplied by 1e6). Captured 2026-10-05; rates drift, so the as-of date is the audit anchor — a chart's costUsd is only defensible against a row from this date.

Shape mirrors config/opencode-go-rates.json so the same rateFor() lookup path serves both. Each entry has tiers[]; OpenRouter's listed rate is the base rate, so there is exactly one tier per model here (maxPromptTokens: null).

The runner stamps pricing: 'pay-per-token' and costUsd from this table when an OpenRouter model resolves a rate and the run carries usage. computeCost() checks config.model.price first (a per-model override in config/models.json) and falls back to this table.
costUsd = (prompt_tokens * inputPer1M + completion_tokens * outputPer1M) / 1e6, rounded to 6dp.
Re-derive a row: node bin/providers.mjs -m openrouter/<id> for the endpoint list, and the /api/v1/models pricing block for the rate. Do not type a number you have no source for.
